title: WoDX Storyteller
description: World of Darkness Expanded: the open world. Players travel and act on their own, each on their own time in the night, with dawn warnings and a limit on solo actions. The Storyteller follows every character on a tracker (where, at what hour, what they did and rolled, and what needs a look), keeps the spotlight even, calls characters together for scenes with their times lined up, sets beats that fire on a time, a place or a flag, and reads a report of what moved between sessions. Encounters, beats that call characters and results that change the world wait in the approval queue. What players do on the map (WoDX Interactables) goes into the log, and a beat can fire on a change on the map. Start a chronicle sets a new world's opening date, place and lines and makes the Storyteller screen, the era primer, the group actor and Session Zero. The night's draw (encounters by era, place, hour and world layer, and a rumour) and story aids (dreams, visions, auguries, foreshadowings, relics, fetishes, talismans) are seeded and go to the approval queue. A prelude makes a Storyteller-only journal of questions and beats for a one-on-one session, by line: the Embrace, the First Change, the Awakening and the rest. Long tasks (making things, research, training, talens, wonders) roll as extended actions when game time passes, with Undo. Havens keep who lives there, their security (harder to break into, by Domain) and who knows the way. Lasting changes keep what has changed for good in a body (Vicissitude, a metis deformity, Moliate, a demon's visage, taint, scars), with any change to Appearance and Undo. Hardship on the road (a setting, off by default): harsh weather, thirst, hunger and lost sleep for living characters, by M20 and HH2, with Undo. The dashboard shows the party, what runs out or comes next, open threads and the debts and grudges that come due. Battles and sieges: two forces fought phase by phase or a siege week by week, by the age of war of the year, with the characters' deeds tipping the result, a progress clock for the walls, and an Undo. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
